<function name="LastShootTime" parent="Weapon" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the time since this weapon last fired a bullet with <page>Entity:FireBullets</page> in seconds. It is not networked.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The time in seconds when the last bullet was fired.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
